skills.description: This skill should be used when computing or explaining the V7.5 RiskV2 individual-stock analysis indicators — BPS six-dimension trend score, Gate4 eight-dimension overheating/reverse timing factor, R:R risk-reward ratio, and EQS entry-quality score. It reproduces the exact threshold logic and per-dimension breakdowns from the production system (final_bps.py / riskv2_analyze.py / final_indicators.py / eqs_diag.py), and documents each indicator's walk-forward / alpha validation结论 and适用边界. Critical honesty: BPS and Gate4 are verified to have NO stock-selection alpha (BPS = 48th percentile random); they are research references, NOT trade signals. This is the "per-stock analysis layer" — complementary to (not duplicated with) rv3-quant-verification (equal-weight core deployment) and rv3-walkforward-validation (candidate gating). Trigger on phrases like "BPS六维", "Gate4过热", "R:R盈亏比", "EQS入场质量", "个股分析指标", "趋势评分", "时机因子", "计算BPS", "Gate4怎么算".
skills.description_zh: 复刻 V7.5 RiskV2 个股分析层的四套指标——BPS 六维趋势评分、Gate4 八维过热时机因子、R:R 风险报酬比、EQS 入场质量评分。纯 pandas 可运行复现，附逐维解读与验证结论。诚实披露：BPS/Gate4 已验证无选股 alpha，仅作研究参考，非选股秘籍。
skills.name: V7.5 RiskV2 个股分析指标套件 · BPS/Gate4/R:R/EQS
